Luca (Sales): Passing Helios Health to CS — trial converted to paid. Key points: SSO via SAML, HIPAA data, want Redwood Dedicated with initial 4 GPU pool and target 12 GPUs within ~90 days. Renewal sensitivity: medical device integrations team wants strict uptime and audit logs. Contract signed; renewal window 2026-10-15. Quick links: onboarding checklist: https://redwood.app/onboard/helios (internal).

Aisha (CS): Thanks Luca — taking ownership. Can you drop SAML metadata + who is the technical contact for SSO? Also any known blockers for data retention/compliance?

Luca (Sales): Yup — SAML metadata file is on the shared drive (link above). Technical contact: Dr. Priya Menon (priya.m@helios.health). Legal noted a standard BAA, signed. Known blocker: they asked about private audit logs and KMS key residency for EU region.

Aisha (CS): Got it. I'll own onboarding and the customer-facing plan. Assigning infra tickets to Rory and eng integration to Nina. Tentative timeline: SSO + network setup in week1, Dedicated pool provisioning week2, validation & test week3. Will set weekly syncs. @Rory @Nina please confirm. :calendar:

Rory (Support): On it. Need VPC peering details and expected egress patterns. Also confirm preferred region — they asked for west-europe fallback.

Nina (Eng): I can take the integration work. Need sample payloads and expected QPS. Any latency SLO they require for inference?

Luca (Sales): Region: primary us-west, fallback eu-west. Expected steady QPS ~25 requests/sec, bursts up to 200 for short windows. Latency target: p95 < 300ms. Sample payloads attached to drive link.

Rory (Support): For infra I'll open infra ticket and request VPC peering. Drafting commands for net team:
```
Request: create-vpc-peering --customer helios --cidr 10.50.0.0/16 --region us-west-2 --tags owner:helios
Note: request private link for audit log streaming to customer's log collector.
```
I'll also flag the KMS residency ask as a blocker until we confirm key storage options.

onboard-bot: Provisioning job queued — job_id=prov-2026-04-12-88; estimated time 6-8 hours. Status: queued -> pending.

Aisha (CS): Action items summary: 1) SSO metadata & test account (Luca / Helios) — due EOD tomorrow. 2) Infra ticket for VPC peering + KMS residency evaluation (Rory) — due in 48h. 3) Dedicated pool initial provisioning (onboard-bot / infra) — target start in 48-72h. 4) Integration test plan + sample traffic (Nina) — draft by next Tue. 5) Renewal risk doc: list triggers and owner (Aisha) — initial draft by next Fri.

Luca (Sales): Noted. One more: integration with the medical device backend requires audit-level traces for 1 year retention. Legal insisted.

Rory (Support): Added retention requirement to infra ticket. Also adding checklist for audit log export and TLS termination.

Nina (Eng): For tests I'll need a staging API key and ~30 minutes of synthetic traffic sim with these params: qps=50, max_seq_len=1024. Can someone provision a staging key?

Aisha (CS): @Luca can you request a staging API key from the customer? I'll include it in the kickoff email.

Luca (Sales): Yep — I'll ping Priya for the staging key today and cc the team.

Aisha (CS): Scheduling weekly 30m syncs starting Tue Apr 14 10:00 PT. I'll post a calendar invite. Please update the:onboarding checklist card with owners. :thumbsup:

Rory (Support): Quick note — if Dedicated initial pool fails capacity checks, fallback plan is hosted burst via regionally compatible instance types. I'll document fallback SLA.

Nina (Eng): Cool. I'll start drafting integration test cases and post them to the shared doc.

Luca (Sales): Thanks team. Priya is responsive; we should be able to move quickly. Ping me if you need escalation for quota or purchasing.

Aisha (CS): Perfect — I'll create the renewal-risk tracker and share it after first sync. Closing handoff for now, will reopen thread with support tickets and prov status updates. :white_check_mark:
